description: Products that require deep discounts to convert or suffer from uncharacteristically high customer return rates.

description: High-ticket products with excellent customer satisfaction, substantial review depth, and strong revenue contribution.

description: High-velocity everyday essentials with strong customer ratings, moderate pricing, and high turnover.

description: Sluggish sales velocity, below-average customer ratings, and low consumer engagement.
commercial_strategy: Inventory: Minimize stock; initiate aggressive clearance sales to free up working capital and warehouse space. | Pricing: Test tactical markdowns to liquidate dormant stock without cannibalizing core lines. | Marketing: Reposition listings with improved keywords or phase out bottom-decile SKUs. | Quality: Investigate low customer ratings (reviews < 3.5); evaluate supplier quality or delist.
